title: Light over the mesa, green light, missing time and Apache helicopters
place_text: Aztec crash site mesa, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Right after we said it was a 90 degree turn [snorts] and we're uh you know and we're walking back down to the rest of the group and uh it it was instantly over us.

plain: On a mesa in New Mexico near Aztec, where a flying saucer is said to have crashed long ago, a camper who is not named says a light in the sky made a sharp 90 degree turn and then was "instantly over us" as the group walked back to camp. The camper, who says they were there, goes on to describe a green light, a stretch of time no one could account for, and Apache military helicopters showing up afterwards. Told as a witness account, it would suggest that something unusual still visits the old crash site.
